### Summary

This PR adds a Vite + React + TypeScript scaffold with react-router and a typed UserContext. It provides a simple Home page (profile view/edit) and an About page.

### Files changed
- Added: src/pages, src/context, and updated package.json

### Migration steps
Follow the steps in the repository README to migrate existing files into the new structure.

### Checklist
- [ ] Run `npm install` and `npm run dev`
- [ ] Verify Home and About pages
